instruction: Which support team should handle this customer ticket?

routes.الفوترة: Invoices, charges, payments, refunds, and subscription billing.
routes.الدعم الفني: Errors, broken features, installation, and integration problems.
routes.الوصول إلى الحساب: Login, passwords, two-factor authentication, and locked accounts.
routes.المبيعات: Product questions, pricing quotes, and purchasing inquiries.
routes.الخدمات اللوجستية: Requests Related to delivery, package delays, Shipping time estimate.
